summary: 输入入口新增单文件支持并补齐单文件调度
details: 新增加载器层 _patch_single_input_support()，让浏览入口支持选择单个文件或文件夹；普通任务的单文件路径会自动切到父目录并通过 _fx_single_input_target 只放行目标文件；单文件模式会临时关闭多线程，避免 process_single_file() 在工作线程里写 UI 日志导致退回原文件；zip 单文件则走临时隔离目录包装原始压缩工作流。新增 single_file_input_pdf_encrypt 与 single_file_input_zip_total 回归，full_debug_test.py 现为 38 项通过，已重打包 dist_release_ascii\\fx_toolbox\\fx_toolbox.exe。未改动批量压缩与添加水印业务逻辑。

summary: 收紧去水印判定，修复误删正常图文
details: 将 remove_watermark_from_word 的加载层补丁改为安全版逐对象判定：优先删除 XMU_DONE 标记对象，并仅在命中 watermark 关键词或满足大尺寸+居中/越界+斜向/半透明特征时删除 shape/inline shape，避免误删正常页眉 logo、小标题和 PDF 转 Word 后的正常 shape 内容；新增 word_remove_wm_preserve_header_assets 回归，full_debug_test.py 现为 39 项通过。

summary: 修复PDF去水印回退失败并保留Word安全删除
details: 在加载层新增 _patch_remove_wm_pdf_fallback()，当 remove_wm 输入中包含 PDF 时，改走 ASCII 临时目录 round-trip：convert_pdf_to_word -> remove_watermark_from_word(is_pdf_source=True) -> convert_doc_to_pdf，避免运行时原始 PDF 去水印失败后直接保留原 PDF；同时保留已有 Word 去水印保守判定策略，避免误删正常页眉图文。已通过 python -m py_compile Fengxi_Toolbox.py full_debug_test.py 与 python full_debug_test.py（39 项，failed: []）。

summary: 新增最高优先级约束：不得删除项目外文件
details: 按用户要求，将‘未经明确授权，不得删除任何项目外文件’写入最高优先级记忆；默认所有删除、清理、回收、覆盖前清空等动作只允许发生在 FengxiToolbox 项目目录内，如命令可能影响项目外路径，必须先停下并取得用户明确同意。

summary: 修复PDF去水印批量COM污染，改为独立Word会话
details: 继续完善去水印功能：定位到 PDF 去水印在批量/连续处理时会因复用同一个 Word.Application 而出现 Open.Sections / RPC 服务器不可用，进而导致后续 PDF 回退保留原文件。将 _create_hidden_word_app() 改为 DispatchEx，并让 _run_remove_wm_pdf_roundtrip() 在每个 PDF 的去水印阶段与导出阶段分别使用独立 Word 会话。专项双 PDF 验证通过，python full_debug_test.py 恢复为 39 项通过、failed: []。

summary: 启动性能优化：对 pdf2docx 与 moviepy 引入运行时懒加载代理
details: 在 _load_runtime_namespace() 前安装懒加载代理，保留 hiddenimports；源码态导入约 1.743s->1.267s，窗口 ready 约 4.923s->3.560s。已通过 py_compile、smoke_test.py、full_debug_test.py(39/39)。

summary: 浏览入口改回 Windows 原生选择器，并保持文件/文件夹同选

summary: 修复系统选择器返回字节路径导致的脏路径与去水印卡住
details: Windows Shell 选择器在当前环境下可能返回 bytes，旧版 _normalize_input_path_value() 直接 str(value) 后生成 b'...' 与 \\x..，并被 abspath 错拼到项目目录下，进而让 remove_wm 拿到脏路径表现为卡住。现新增 _decode_input_path_bytes() 与 _coerce_input_path_text() 统一修复 bytes / b'...' / 被污染前缀路径。已通过 py_compile、smoke_test.py、full_debug_test.py(39/39)。

summary: 修复拖拽单文件被降级为文件夹，并修正去水印单文件结果目录拼接
details: 加载层新增 _patch_drag_drop_input_support()，拖拽单文件时保留精确文件路径，不再强制转父目录；同时 _run_remove_wm_task() 增加 input_root，避免把结果目录拼成 某文件.pdf\\【处理完成】结果文件夹。已通过定向探针验证，以及 py_compile、smoke_test.py、full_debug_test.py(39/39)。

summary: 修复去水印单文件输出规则并阻止PDF失败伪成功
details: 新增单文件去水印输出策略：默认同目录生成 _去水印 文件，可选成功后覆盖原文件；PDF round-trip 现在要求 remove_watermark_from_word 成功且 cleaned.docx 存在，否则直接记失败且不再复制原 PDF 伪装结果。新增 pdf_remove_wm_single_file_output / pdf_remove_wm_single_file_overwrite 回归，smoke_test.py 12/12、full_debug_test.py 41/41 通过。

summary: 修复OCR单文件与拖拽输入路径拼接

summary: 修复打包版 OCR 的 onnxruntime 运行库冲突

summary: 统一修复运行时进度条并接入OCR页级进度

summary: history detail export
details: Added a 导出结果 action to the task history detail dialog, exporting the current entry's structured task_result JSON with a safe default filename. Added regression checks for filename safety, export success, and empty-entry rejection. Also made the full debug test tolerate a PowerPoint COM Close() hiccup during teardown so the suite finishes cleanly.

summary: history detail log export
details: Added a 导出日志 action to the task history detail dialog. It exports a plain text snapshot of the current entry's title, task, status, input, timestamps, and log lines, using a safe default filename and a clean empty-log fallback. Added regression checks for filename safety, successful log export, and empty-log handling.

summary: history detail open output location
details: Added an 打开位置 action to the task history detail dialog. It opens the current entry's best available target on Windows, preferring output_root, then the first output file's parent, then the input's parent directory. Added regression checks for opening output_root, falling back from an output file to its parent directory, and rejecting empty targets.

summary: history detail failure grouping and highlighting
details: Extended the task history detail dialog with explicit failure sections: failure overview, failure reason, failed items, and key failure logs. Added text-tag highlighting for failed headers, failure text, failed-item lines, and error logs inside the history detail textbox. Added regression checks for grouped failure text and textbox tag ranges. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 79/79.

summary: history failure classification preview
details: Added a lightweight failure classification layer for task history entries so failed rows can surface path-missing, permission, timeout, dependency, partial-failure, and generic failure hints. The history search blob now includes failure kind and reason, and the list view can display the failure label alongside the existing detail lines. Added regression checks for path-missing classification and search-blob inclusion. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 81/81.

summary: subwindow app icon and history failure filter
details: Applied the Fengxi app icon to child windows including the unified file/folder picker, task history detail dialog, and queue/history window so subpages no longer fall back to generic icons. Continued the unfinished next step by wiring failure-category filtering into task history with a new failure filter option menu, matching filter state, and search support for classified failure reasons. Added regression checks for path-missing failure filtering through both direct helper filtering and app-bound filter state. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 83/83.

summary: task history report export
details: Added Markdown task report export to task history detail, with a new 导出报告 action beside result/log export and open-location. The report reuses structured task_result, failure classification, output paths, failed items, and key logs so history export semantics stay aligned with the unified task result model. Added regression coverage for safe report filename generation, successful export, empty-entry rejection, and failed-entry report sections. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 87/87.

summary: remove_wm single-file overwrite output strategy fix
details: Closed the remaining output-strategy regression in single-file remove-watermark overwrite mode. The loader-layer remove_wm flow now always writes a staged file into a temporary result folder first, then safely replaces the original only on success, instead of accidentally treating the original file path as the staged artifact. Also completed structured task_result writeback for single-file remove_wm success/failure paths and normalized remove_wm aggregate counts to total_items so history/export/retry stay aligned. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 88/88.

summary: remove_wm graded modes
details: Added conservative/standard/aggressive remove-watermark modes with conservative as default, local preference memory under watermark.remove_wm_mode, UI selector and mode-aware Word/PDF detection thresholds. Cleaned a stale misplaced result-model block in the unified picker. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 92/92.

summary: queue history auto pruning
details: Added 90-day queue history retention while keeping the existing 80-entry cap. History load/save/append now prune stale timestamped entries and persist the cleaned list; legacy undated entries are retained to avoid accidental data loss. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 93/93.

summary: true progress status text
details: Upgraded runtime progress reporting with a bottom status text that shows current file, stage, completed/total files, total percentage, and ETA. Tracker now owns stage/file/ETA state and custom workflows report clearer phases for OCR, PDF compression, image-to-PDF, image merge, and PDF remove-watermark round-trip without changing stable business logic. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 95/95.

summary: preset center

Presets are stored in user prefs under presets, can be saved/applied/deleted by category, and PDF presets synchronize the right-side mode panel. Added regression coverage for all four preset categories. Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 99/99.

summary: make preset center visible in sidebar

Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 100/100.

summary: last settings automatic memory

Validation: py_compile passed, smoke_test 14/14, full_debug_test 100/100.
